mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, create_user_id, create_time, update_user_id, update_time, deleted_at, version, resource_id, version_id, env_code, namespace_id, kind, chunk_index, chunk_text, chunk_sha256, embedding, indexed_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ddc_si_embedding_chunk WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT FROM ddc_si_embedding_chunk WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND id IN #{id} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ddc_si_embedding_chunk ( id, tenant_id, create_user_id, create_time, update_user_id, update_time, deleted_at, version, resource_id, version_id, env_code, namespace_id, kind, chunk_index, chunk_text, chunk_sha256, embedding, search_tsv, indexed_time ) VALUES ( #{chunk.id}, #{chunk.tenantId}, #{chunk.createUserId}, #{chunk.createTime}, #{chunk.updateUserId}, #{chunk.updateTime}, #{chunk.deletedAt}, #{chunk.version}, #{chunk.resourceId}, #{chunk.versionId}, #{chunk.envCode}, #{chunk.namespaceId}, #{chunk.kind}, #{chunk.chunkIndex}, #{chunk.chunkText}, #{chunk.chunkSha256}, CAST(#{embeddingLiteral} AS vector), to_tsvector('simple', coalesce(#{chunk.chunkText}, '')), #{chunk.indexedTime} )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ddc_si_embedding_chunk WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND version_id = #{versionId}
mapper.select: WITH vec_ranked AS ( SELECT c.resource_id, c.version_id, c.chunk_text, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (c.embedding <=> CAST(#{queryVectorLiteral} AS vector)) ASC) AS r_vec FROM ddc_si_embedding_chunk c JOIN ddc_si_resource r ON r.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND r.id = c.resource_id WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.env_code = #{envCode} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.lifecycle_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND r.current_version_id = c.version_id AND c.namespace_id = #{namespaceId} AND c.kind = #{kind} ORDER BY (c.embedding <=> CAST(#{queryVectorLiteral} AS vector)) ASC LIMIT #{candidateLimit} ), vec_hits AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (resource_id) resource_id, version_id, chunk_text, r_vec FROM vec_ranked ORDER BY resource_id, r_vec ASC ), fts_ranked AS ( SELECT r.id AS resource_id, r.current_version_id AS version_id, r.description AS chunk_text, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY ts_rank(r.search_tsv, plainto_tsquery('simple', #{queryText})) DESC, r.id DESC ) AS r_fts FROM ddc_si_resource r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.env_code = #{envCode} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.lifecycle_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND r.search_tsv @@ plainto_tsquery('simple', #{queryText}) AND r.namespace_id = #{namespaceId} AND r.kind = #{kind} ORDER BY ts_rank(r.search_tsv, plainto_tsquery('simple', #{queryText})) DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{candidateLimit} ) SELECT r.id AS resource_id, r.tenant_id, r.namespace_id, r.env_code, r.app_code, r.kind, r.resource_key, r.display_name, r.description, COALESCE(vh.version_id, fh.version_id, r.current_version_id) AS version_id, COALESCE(vh.chunk_text, fh.chunk_text, r.description) AS chunk_text, (COALESCE(1.0 / (#{rrfK} + vh.r_vec), 0.0) + COALESCE(1.0 / (#{rrfK} + fh.r_fts), 0.0)) AS rrf_score FROM vec_hits vh FULL OUTER JOIN fts_ranked fh ON fh.resource_id = vh.resource_id JOIN ddc_si_resource r ON r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.id = COALESCE(vh.resource_id, fh.resource_id) WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY rrf_score DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{topK}

SELECT r.id AS resource_id, r.tenant_id, r.namespace_id, r.env_code, r.app_code, r.kind, r.resource_key, r.display_name, r.description, r.current_version_id AS version_id, r.description AS chunk_text, ts_rank(r.search_tsv, plainto_tsquery('simple', #{queryText}))::float8 AS rrf_score FROM ddc_si_resource r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.env_code = #{envCode} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.lifecycle_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND ( r.search_tsv @@ plainto_tsquery('simple', #{queryText}) OR r.resource_key ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryText}, '%') OR r.display_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryText}, '%') OR r.description ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryText}, '%') ) AND r.namespace_id = #{namespaceId} AND r.kind = #{kind} ORDER BY rrf_score DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{topK}
